note: Session tools are the live agent-exposed fleet for this unit. Estate packages are on-disk under tools/. PATH CLIs are resolved with shutil.which against /usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin so agent-injected PATH (cursor-agent bundled rg/node) cannot change catalog size between delivery and remasure. No MCP server JSON was assumed; candidate paths were probed.
